sentences.text: This genus is defined by its distinct circular body shape.
It possessed a very short tail equipped with a venomous stinger.
One species could reach a length of about 25 cm.
Another species was smaller, reaching only around 15 cm.
The genus was described by Egerton in 1844.
It belongs to the extinct family Cyclobatidae.
Three species are recognized within the genus: Cyclobatis longicanudatus, Cyclobatis major, and Cyclobatis oligodactylus.
These creatures lived in warm, shallow seas.
They existed between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago during the Cenomanian stage.
